info.title: Kpler AIS API
info.description:
The AIS (Automatic Identification System) APIs provide access to vessel position data collected from Kpler’s global network of terrestrial, roaming and satellite receivers. They deliver both real-time and historical AIS information, enabling users to track vessel movements, analyze traffic patterns and integrate maritime positional data into their applications.

This section includes:

* **AIS – Latest:** Access to the most recent known position for each vessel worldwide, updated in near real time.

All AIS data are delivered in consistent formats (GeoJSON or CSV) and support advanced spatial and attribute-based filtering for flexible integration into analytical or GIS workflows.

tags.name: AIS - Historical
tags.description:
AIS – Historical

Kpler AIS – Historical returns vessel AIS positions over a requested time window. Use it to retrieve either all received positions or downsampled positions for selected vessels or for vessels within a selected geographic area. Unlike AIS – Latest (one latest position per vessel), this endpoint can return multiple positions per vessel within the requested period.

The filter must include a time range (posDt) plus either a vessel identifier (vesselUid or mmsi) or an area filter (bbox/polygon/multipolygon). More details on filter requirements can be found here: Kpler AIS Tutorials.

Historical coverage currently starts on 2025-12-01, with data back to 2015-01-01 planned to be made available in the coming months.

Rate limit: 300 requests per minute.

tags.name: AIS - Latest
tags.description:
Kpler AIS – Latest provides the most recent known AIS positions for all vessels matching the user’s filters. Positions are updated continuously, offering near real-time visibility into global maritime activity. Results can be filtered by vessel identifiers, geographic areas or dynamic attributes such as speed, navigational status or vessel type.

See this tutorial for supported filtering operators and Python code examples.

Rate limit: 300 requests per minute.

get.description: Returns one latest available position received in the past 7 days per vessel.

Each request must include a posDt time range and at least one query scope,  (vesselUid, mmsi) or a geographic constraint (BBOX or polygon/multipolygon). defined by either vessel identifiers (vesselUid, mmsi) and/or a geographic constraint (bbox, polygon, multipolygon). When querying by vessel identifiers, up to 10 vessels can be provided per request, with a maximum date range of 366 days. When querying by geographic area, the selected area must not exceed 55,000 km², and the maximum date range is limited to 1 day. parameters.name: downsample
parameters.description: Controls whether historical positions are returned in full (none) or reduced (dynamic); dynamic downsampling keeps at least one position every 10 minutes and additionally preserves positions where the absolute change in rate of turn is ≥ 10 degrees or speed over ground is ≥ 10 knots.

Feature.description: A GeoJSON Feature object representing a vessel position.

id.description: Unique identifier assigned to this vessel position record

geometry.description: Spatial geometry describing the vessel's current position

geometry_name.description: Vessel’s position in WGS84 coordinates (longitude, latitude)

properties.description: A set of properties/attributes associated with the vessel's position.

type.description: GeoJSON geometry type. Always Point for this endpoint

coordinates.description: The WGS84 coordinates in [longitude, latitude] order.

totalFeatures.description: Total number of vessel positions matching the query

numberMatched.description: Number of features that satisfy the filter criteria

numberReturned.description: Number of features included in this response

timeStamp.description: Timestamp when this response was generated (ISO 8601)

crs.description: Coordinate reference system information for the returned GeoJSON

vesselUid.description: Unique vessel identifier assigned by MarineTraffic.

navStatus.description: Navigational Status Code as reported in the AIS message.

posMsgType.description: Type of the positional AIS message.

posSrcText.description: Source of the positional AIS message (TER / ROAM / SAT).

flag.description: Two-letter ISO country code of vessel’s registration.

vesselTypeAis.description: Vessel type code reported in the AIS message.

vesselType.description: Type assigned to the vessel by MarineTraffic.

destination.description: Destination reported in the AIS message.

eta.description: Estimated Time of Arrival reported in the AIS message (ISO 8601).

staticMsgType.description: Type of the static AIS message.

staticSrcText.description: Source of the static AIS message (TER / ROAM / SAT).

posDt.description: Time and date when positional AIS message was emitted (ISO 8601).

staticDt.description: Time and date when static AIS message was emitted (ISO 8601).

insertDt.description: Time and date when the record was inserted into Kpler's database (ISO 8601).
